image_description: A close-up shot of an adult guenon monkey (likely a Vervet or similar species) sitting on a textured tree branch. The monkey has greenish-grey fur on its back, black limbs, and a white chest/belly area. It features a distinctive black face with a white beard/ruff around the mouth and cheeks. A baby monkey is clinging tightly to the adult's chest, mostly obscured by the adult's arm and body, with only its dark fur and part of its head visible. The background is a soft-focus green foliage.
